rules.name: Family Cup (no Pokémon energy)
rules.notes: Rule B without Pokémon-as-energy: 30-card decks, 3 prize cards, standard Basic Energy only (Pokémon in hand are not Basic Energy). Energy Search finds Energy cards, not Pokémon. Copy cap 4 except basic Energy. Knocking Out a Pokémon ex takes 2 prize cards; Knocking Out a Mega ex takes 3. Opening mulligans until a Basic Pokémon.
